selection_rule: Select and adapt only artifacts required by the approved specification and proposed workflow.

artifacts.purpose: Define the primary execution agent as an intent-preserving project responder.
artifacts.use_when: Codex is assigned implementation, repair, or integration work.
artifacts.avoid_when: The workflow has no Codex execution node.

artifacts.purpose: Start bounded implementation from approved intent and repository evidence.
artifacts.avoid_when: The node is read-only research, review, or presentation.

artifacts.purpose: Verify observable acceptance criteria without redefining completion.
artifacts.use_when: The workflow makes testable implementation claims.
artifacts.avoid_when: No executable or inspectable result is produced.

artifacts.purpose: Review an immutable checkpoint adversarially and reproducibly.
artifacts.use_when: Independent review is required by the user or risk warrants it.
artifacts.avoid_when: The reviewer cannot be independent from the work being reviewed.

artifacts.purpose: Drive bounded, finding-specific remediation without graph cycles.
artifacts.use_when: A review node permits repair attempts.
artifacts.avoid_when: The workflow requires an immediate user decision instead of repair.

artifacts.purpose: Return verified deliverables without importing initialization deliberation.
artifacts.use_when: The workflow produces a durable project result.
artifacts.avoid_when: No separate execution handoff is needed.

artifacts.purpose: Keep runtime intervention capture sparse and epistemically bounded.
artifacts.use_when: The workflow permits adaptive local repair.
artifacts.avoid_when: Execution is fully read-only or adaptation is forbidden.
